pricingComputed.implementationFeeNote: IaaS model — implementation cost absorbed into the $300/flow/month rate. Kickoff retainer $2,500 (1–5 flow band) is non-refundable at SOW signing and fully credited against the first 6-month payment at go-live.
pricingComputed.timelineBreakdown: Requirements & Analysis 2 weeks + Development & Testing (4 flows × 1.5 weeks = 6 weeks) = 8 weeks total
pricingComputed.implementationOnlyNote: Standard rate: 4 flows × $3,500 = $14,000. Paid 50% at SOW signing + 50% at UAT sign-off. Code ownership transfers to Peerless at go-live; no ongoing DataSkate service.
pricingComputed.recommendedModelRationale: IaaS is the recommended model for Peerless for five compounding reasons: (1) ComputerEase is Deltek-classified legacy with a 4-hour minimum support SLA and CE Live Service relay plumbing — ongoing monitoring and incident response have continuous operational value, not one-time build value. (2) MuleSoft IDP requires a manual-review queue and rule-library tuning as new contract templates appear or HD-side document formats shift — that is operational work, not implementation work. (3) Peerless has no in-house MuleSoft developer; Brian Cook is the platform IT director but has explicitly stated he is not the integration owner ('I'm in' to GCP only to debug, not to operate). (4) Akoya is a PE sponsor actively hunting another Home Services platform — a managed-service relationship gives DataSkate continuous touchpoints during the 18-month window President Roger Greenhagel uses to modernize IT, positioning DataSkate for the next Akoya platform play. (5) The Elevate Fence Partners national-rollout thesis means UC1–UC4 are the template for 5 additional sibling brands — that template needs ongoing maintenance as state-specific rules (Wisconsin 99% deposit becomes N exceptions) accumulate. Implementation Only would treat this as a one-time build and forfeit the recurring template-evolution role.
edgeCases: Flow count is 4 — sits at the top of the 1–5 retainer band ($2,500). If Peerless promotes UC5 (deposit-paid) and UC6 (subcontract worksheet) to confirmed in a Phase 1b expansion, retainer would jump to $5,000 (6–10 band) and 2-year total scales linearly.

Implementation Only delta: at 4 flows, IaaS Year 1 ($14,760) is just under Implementation Only flat fee ($14,000) — but IaaS carries no Year 2 upside for Peerless if they self-maintain. Implementation Only is the right fit only if Peerless hires a MuleSoft developer before kickoff — they have not signaled this.
Anypoint license bundling: pricing-model.md row 'AE sells full $50K Anypoint license → $0 implementation' is not in play at Peerless — no Anypoint license sale discussed in scoping.
